lemma base:
  fixes n :: nat
  shows "(\<Sum>i<0. 2 * i + 1) = (0::nat)^2"

lemma reduction:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator: "0 < b"
  shows "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
held_out_proof:
proof -
    have denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
      using denominator by simp
    have common_positive: "0 < (gcd a b)"
    proof -
      have not_both_zero: "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"
        using denominator_nonzero by blast
      show ?thesis
        using not_both_zero by simp
    qed
    have numerator_rebuild: "a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b))"
    proof -
      have numerator_divides: "(gcd a b) dvd a"
        by simp
      have numerator_cancel: "(gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) = a"
        using numerator_divides by (rule dvd_mult_div_cancel)
      show ?thesis
        using numerator_cancel by simp
    qed
    have denominator_rebuild: "b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b))"
    proof -
      have denominator_divides: "(gcd a b) dvd b"
        by simp
      have denominator_cancel: "(gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) = b"
        using denominator_divides by (rule dvd_mult_div_cancel)
      show ?thesis
        using denominator_cancel by simp
    qed
    have reduced_coprime: "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
    proof -
      have nonzero_pair: "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"
        using denominator_nonzero by blast
      have cancellation: "coprime (a div gcd a b) (b div gcd a b)"
        using nonzero_pair by (rule div_gcd_coprime)
      show ?thesis
        using cancellation by simp
    qed
    show ?thesis
      using common_positive numerator_rebuild denominator_rebuild reduced_coprime by blast
  qed

lemma induction_step:
  fixes n :: nat
  assumes next_sum: "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) + (2 * k + 1)"
    and next_square: "\<And>k::nat. k^2 + (2 * k + 1) = (Suc k)^2"
  shows "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2 \<Longrightarrow> (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (Suc k)^2"

lemma not_both_zero:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"

lemma all_n:
  fixes n :: nat
  assumes base: "(\<Sum>i<0. 2 * i + 1) = (0::nat)^2"
    and induction_step: "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2 \<Longrightarrow> (\<Sum>i<Suc k. 2 * i + 1) = (Suc k)^2"
  shows "\<And>k::nat. (\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2"
held_out_proof:
proof -
    fix k :: nat
    show "(\<Sum>i<k. 2 * i + 1) = k^2"
      by (induction k) (use base induction_step in auto)
  qed

lemma nonzero_pair:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes denominator_nonzero: "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"

lemma cancellation:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes nonzero_pair: "a \<noteq> 0 \<or> b \<noteq> 0"
  shows "coprime (a div gcd a b) (b div gcd a b)"

lemma reduced_square:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes square: "a^2 = n * b^2"
    and reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "(a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
held_out_proof:
proof -
    have common_nonzero: "(gcd a b) \<noteq> 0"
      using reduction by simp
    have common_square_nonzero: "(gcd a b)^2 \<noteq> 0"
      using common_nonzero by simp
    have numerator_expansion: "a^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2"
    proof -
      have numerator_factor: "a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b))"
        using reduction by blast
      have numerator_power: "((gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2"
        by (rule power_mult_distrib)
      show ?thesis
        using numerator_factor numerator_power by simp
    qed
    have denominator_expansion: "b^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
    proof -
      have denominator_factor: "b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b))"
        using reduction by blast
      have denominator_power: "((gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
        by (rule power_mult_distrib)
      show ?thesis
        using denominator_factor denominator_power by simp
    qed
    have scaled_equality: "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
      using square numerator_expansion denominator_expansion by simp
    have reorder: "n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2) = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
      by (simp add: mult_ac)
    have cancellable: "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
      using scaled_equality reorder by simp
    show ?thesis
      using common_square_nonzero cancellable by (simp only: mult_cancel_left) blast
  qed

lemma denominator_factor:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma denominator_power:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "((gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"

lemma scaled_equality:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes square: "a^2 = n * b^2"
    and numerator_expansion: "a^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2"
    and denominator_expansion: "b^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
  shows "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
held_out_proof: using square numerator_expansion denominator_expansion by simp

lemma reorder:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  shows "n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2) = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"

lemma cancellable:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes scaled_equality: "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
    and reorder: "n * ((gcd a b)^2 * (b div (gcd a b))^2) = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"
  shows "(gcd a b)^2 * (a div (gcd a b))^2 = (gcd a b)^2 * (n * (b div (gcd a b))^2)"

lemma denominator_one:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
    and reduced_square: "(a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
  shows "(b div (gcd a b)) = 1"
held_out_proof:
proof -
    have coprime_squares: "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) ((b div (gcd a b))^2)"
    proof -
      have reduced_pair: "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
        using reduction by blast
      have square_left: "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) (b div (gcd a b))"
        using reduced_pair by simp
      show ?thesis
        using square_left by simp
    qed
    have denominator_dvd: "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd (a div (gcd a b))^2"
    proof -
      have divides_product: "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
        by simp
      show ?thesis
        using divides_product reduced_square by simp
    qed
    have square_is_one: "(b div (gcd a b))^2 = 1"
    proof -
      have divides_itself: "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd (b div (gcd a b))^2"
        by simp
      have common_is_unit: "is_unit ((b div (gcd a b))^2)"
        using coprime_squares denominator_dvd divides_itself by (rule coprime_common_divisor)
      show ?thesis
        using common_is_unit by simp
    qed
    show ?thesis
      using square_is_one by simp
  qed

lemma coprime_squares:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) ((b div (gcd a b))^2)"
held_out_proof:
proof -
      have reduced_pair: "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
        using reduction by blast
      have square_left: "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) (b div (gcd a b))"
        using reduced_pair by simp
      show ?thesis
        using square_left by simp
    qed

lemma reduced_pair:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduction: "0 < (gcd a b) \<and> a = (gcd a b) * (a div (gcd a b)) \<and> b = (gcd a b) * (b div (gcd a b)) \<and> coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma square_left:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduced_pair: "coprime (a div (gcd a b)) (b div (gcd a b))"
  shows "coprime ((a div (gcd a b))^2) (b div (gcd a b))"

lemma denominator_dvd:
  fixes n a b :: nat
  assumes reduced_square: "(a div (gcd a b))^2 = n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
  shows "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd (a div (gcd a b))^2"
held_out_proof:
proof -
      have divides_product: "(b div (gcd a b))^2 dvd n * (b div (gcd a b))^2"
        by simp
      show ?thesis
        using divides_product reduced_square by simp
    qed
